slides.quip:

sections.heading: 1. How to read it
lines: ① Green: up to 3/10, settles overnight → carry on.
② Amber: 4–5/10 or lingers → cut weight or reps.
③ Red: sharp pain or swelling → stop that one.
④ Log scores during and next morning for a week.

sections.heading: 2. Stop straight away if…
lines: Something gives way, or you get numbness
or tingling. Get it assessed first.

slides.title: Hit a red light?
slides.bubble:
Causes differ for everyone.
An assessment comes first!
slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Day three of a new program and Toto's calves are throbbing. Keep going or rest?

Some discomfort is common when you start something new. Think traffic light. Green: an ache up to about 3 out of 10 that stays steady and settles by next morning, carry on. Amber: 4 or 5 out of 10, or lingering into the next day, trim the weight, range or reps for a session or two. Red: sharp pain, swelling, giving way, numbness or tingling, stop and get it checked.

Log your scores for a week and patterns appear fast. Our team at Hybrid Physio can help you set the right dose. Book online via the link in bio 🚦

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
